svg.title: ArchFlow output validation and receipt flow
svg.desc: Specialist candidate outputs enter one requirements and authority gate, then become a repair, approval wait, verified artifact, exact action receipt, or reviewed knowledge candidate.
svg.text: Output flow — responsibility becomes evidence, not silent execution
Every specialist delivers a candidate plus claim table and verification plan; the typed state controller routes the case; requirements and independent review decide advancement.

text.tspan: typed state · append-only receipts · bounded repair
interrupt before private, external, or irreversible work
actor + exact target + operation + data class
approval, reversibility, and rollback must match
deterministic tests · claim/rights scan · visual QA
failure evidence becomes a bounded repair packet
reviewer reports findings; maker performs repair
one approved action · action_id replay protection
read target state; never infer result from command success
knowledge librarian checks duplicates and lineage
promote reusable meaning, not raw trace or secrets
tests, reviewer verdict, and remaining gaps
action ID · exact target · observed result ·
Possible terminal states: verified · repair · approval wait · blocked · stopped · accepted result · closed without promotion.
A generated response, role message, or successful command is never an execution or outcome receipt by itself.
